other_conditions: Applicant must submit the application in the prescribed format with all mandatory documents
Applicant must pay his/her share of the premium via demand draft or online mode
Applicant must keep the policy document safe and provide the policy number to the Board
Accident must be reported to the Board within 72 hours of occurrence
In case of accident, claimant must submit a claim form along with mandatory documents
benefits_summary: Provides a sum insured of up to ₹7 lakhs for death or total permanent disability and additional accident benefits such as partial disability compensation, hospital expense reimbursement, ambulance charges, weekly compensation, bystander and funeral expenses.
documents_required: Countersignature by Agriculture officer/Panchayath President/CPF office bearers/CPC Directors
